releaseStatus.reason: Gate 2 requires approved C6 and C7 entries for both classification and detection and a measured assist quality baseline (SPI-17, NFR-ANN-006). Approved: C6 classification MobileNetV3 Large IMAGENET1K_V2 and C6 detection SSDLite320 MobileNetV3 Large COCO_V1, both under an owner risk acceptance for the rights layer (FR-LIC-016) with measured windows-x64 cpu and directml parity; per the owner ruling D1 of 2026-09-23, the POC-03 real-time criteria are verified on the product Model Version inference path in the INF phase rather than on C6 base weights. Not approved: C7 classification google/siglip-base-patch16-224 is pending (its cpu inference latency p95 545-831 ms failed the adoption record criterion; the planned int8 dynamic quantization failed both parity (max score diff 0.090, top-1 12/15) and cpu performance (p95 216 ms, 8.3 FPS)); C7 classification TinyCLIP ViT-8M/16 is excluded because no primary source states its intended or out-of-scope use; C7 detection google/owlvit-base-patch32 is pending (raw ONNX outputs match PyTorch, but its cpu inference latency p95 918-1570 ms failed the adoption record criterion); C7 detection IDEA-Research/grounding-dino-tiny is pending because its ONNX export does not match PyTorch (parity FAIL). The assist quality baseline (releaseStatus.assistQuality) has not been measured. Gate 2 therefore remains closed.
